points.why: It says each vendor can truthfully claim spec compliance because the failure lies in the interaction, which neither spec covers.
It traces the full loop, shows each agent's action distorting the signal the other reads, and names the three-week delay as structural.
It describes the cross-agent signal path and adds a human gate, but never recommends mapping which agent reads and acts on which outputs or flagging the unsupervised agent-to-agent path.
It covers discount and order caps, cooldowns, combined-metric monitoring and a named owner, and it recommends partial-gap ordering while warning against reacting harder.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly says neither agent is at fault.

notes: Its definition of inventory position subtracts forecast lead-time demand, which is nonstandard (normally on-hand plus on-order minus backorders), but this is minor.
